children: Lending growth at Gulf banks rebounds in the second quarter, suggesting the slowdown following the outbreak of regional conflict was relatively short-lived, Kamco Invest says. Gross lending at 55 listed GCC banks rises 2.6% from the previous quarter to a record $2.59 trillion, with all six GCC markets recording sequential growth. The recovery follows an eight-quarter low in lending growth in the first quarter. Aggregate net profit also reaches a record $17.7 billion, up 7.2% on year, showing continued resilience despite regional disruption. (farhan.rafid@wsj.com)
